verified_results.statement: The MD-2S program remains separated into historical legacy reproduction, current canonical physical rebuild and manufactured C1 verification tracks.
The fixed tau pole chart and little-Holder profile, target and ambient spaces encode the smooth-pole class and provide a dense smooth core.
The regularized M1 bulk and boundary expressions define a smooth nonlinear Banach-space map on the positive admissible set.
The full parameter-augmented cap derivative is frozen as an 8 by 22 symbolic trace template, not as an evaluated matrix or rank result.
For a fixed admissible background symbol W_star the bounded linearization has closed graph in the bounded-map sense; no unbounded realization or Fredholm property is established.
The preregistered uncorrected local C1-V predictor exhibits a quadratic normalized-residual regime in the tested finite discretizations.

open_blockers.statement: The provenance-complete historical A0 action, solver and run package remain missing.
No governed M1 candidate-background construction protocol, fixed model-sector instance, residual norm, convergence plan or fail-closed acceptance criterion has yet been preregistered.
The numerical full trace rank, kernel, cokernel, Fredholm property, continuum Jacobian, existence, uniqueness and conditioning remain unproven.
The six model-shape parameters and dimensional anchor have not passed sensitivity-rank, prior-robustness or six-to-four-dimensional normalization audits.
The local second-order discrete C1-V response remains uncomputed.
The scalar-vector-tensor quadratic action and all ghost, gradient and mass-spectrum stability conditions remain open.

active_assumptions: HZT-M0-S6-C-PHYS-M1 remains a versioned physical candidate family, not a confirmed theory.
A fixed little-Holder exponent alpha_H lies strictly between zero and one and is unrelated to model couplings.
The admissible set has rho_N>0, rho_S>0 and Lhat_s>0 on the fixed interval.
No numerical trace or linearized operator is evaluated before a separately governed W_star exists.
BACKGROUND-3A is method preregistration only and does not authorize a solver run.
forbidden_inferences: Do not infer that the solution set G^{-1}(0) is nonempty.
Do not infer trace rank from the 8 by 22 symbolic template.
Do not infer Fredholmness or invertibility from bounded-map closedness.
Do not infer physical background, stability or ghost freedom.
Do not change R1.1, R1.2, solver authorization, K1-D or K1-E without a later versioned gate decision.
